Subject: SIG evidence request: penetration-test report and extracts

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for partnering with us on the SIG review. Our compliance team flagged the penetration-test report as a required artifact for the SIG questionnaire (they accept redacted copies). For the request (GRC-87231) we need the following by EOD 2027-05-06 if possible: 

- Penetration-test report (redacted copy acceptable)
- Findings CSV or mapping file with each finding, severity, and remediation status
- Scope/network diagram showing in-scope endpoints and cloud regions

Upload directly to our GRC portal here: https://grc.sigmahealth.com/upload/records/ZZ7Y-20270502 (use request id GRC-87231 in the metadata). Please confirm whether you will upload redacted artifacts or if you prefer to send them to our secure intake email (grc-upload@sigmahealth.com).

If redaction/NDAs are required for the non-redacted report, flag that in your reply and we can arrange an encrypted transfer.

Appreciate a quick note on ETA.

Best,
Alice

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list.

Confirming we received GRC-87231. I'll coordinate with our security team to produce a redacted PT report and the findings CSV. A few quick clarifying points:

- Redacted report is fine for the SIG questionnaire — we typically remove internal hostnames, private IPs, and any customer identifiers.
- Do you need the original non-redacted copy under NDA, or is redacted sufficient for your auditor?
- For the scope diagram, do you prefer a PNG/PDF image or a Visio/Draw.io file?

I'll aim to have the redacted report and findings CSV uploaded to the portal by EOD 2027-05-04, and will loop back if we need to request an NDA for the full report. Monica — can you confirm export availability and whether there's a pre-redaction checklist we should follow?

Thanks,

On Mon, May 2, 2027 at 10:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Monica — can you confirm export availability and whether there's a pre-redaction checklist we should follow?

Hi all —

We completed a third-party pen test on 2027-03-20 performed by NorthStar Security. The full report is in our internal S3 (access-controlled). Per standard procedure we can produce a redacted report for GRC uploads. Redaction scope: remove internal hostnames, private/internal IP ranges (10./172./192.168/172), and any customer or partner-specific identifiers. Sensitive exploit POCs are summarized rather than included.

Files I can attach to this thread for your upload now:
- redacted-pt-report-sigmahealth-202703-redacted.pdf (redaction: hostnames/IPs removed, PII scrubbed)
- pt-findings-summary-202703.csv (fields: finding_id, title, severity, component, status, owner)
- vuln-triage-20270401.txt (triage notes + remediation timeline)

I can also export the scope diagram (scope-diagram-sigmahealth.png) — I will attach that if you want it as a PNG.

If you need the non-redacted report for legal review, we will require a signed NDA and a secure transfer (SFTP or encrypted ShareFile).

Let me know whether to upload directly to the GRC portal or to send to grc-upload@sigmahealth.com.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Information Security Lead
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — I can confirm I see the uploads in GRC (GRC-87231). The file names look good and the summary CSV should be sufficient for initial review. Two quick follow-ups:

1) Can you add a column in the CSV that maps each finding to the applicable SIG control ID (if you have them)? That would speed up our auditor's crosswalk.
2) Scope diagram looks fine — thanks for including it. If possible, could you also provide a one-page inventory list of in-scope services (service name, cloud region, owned-by) — a short CSV is fine.

If we need the full non-redacted report later we will request an NDA. For now this should allow the SIG questionnaire to proceed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Manager, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Sigma Health
